# Device Battery Status 1.2.0 candidate

Verified software candidate awaiting the user's publication decision. Packages are unsigned.

Adds capacity-health calculation and provenance/history from explicit full-capacity fields or complete measured current/power discharge cycles, plus compact details and sourced design entry. No currently admitted physical Razer, Logitech or Alienware model provides sufficient telemetry for health; those devices explicitly report Capacity measurement unavailable. Percentage, voltage and runtime never become capacity.

Reduces repeated discovery and failed-device queries through caching, Windows PnP invalidation, coalescing and bounded backoff. Sleep cancels battery/manual work, independent freshness remains active while awake, and unchanged popup/details/tray inputs avoid redundant presentation work. Existing monitoring remains read-only and deliberate manual polling controls are preserved.

Windows verification: 1019 C# cases in each Debug/Release configuration, 5 parser and 18 release-policy cases; 12 isolated application checks per package flavor; 64 installer lifecycle checks including capacity-history preservation. The synthetic 200-trial workload retained healthy cadence while reducing enumerations 8000→800 and queries 16000→12200. CPU/memory observations are short process-wide samples, not physical/endurance claims.

Physical health support, normal live monitoring, actual USB/PnP/power/Explorer interactions, physical DPI, vendor coexistence and extended performance/endurance remain unverified. No release has been published for this candidate. See [the change report](../../docs/capacity-health-and-efficiency.md) for files, affected functions, actual CPU/memory/handle measurements and source/run provenance.
